remaining_census.scope: Unchanged-source and byte-identical cached HTML only. Sixty separately reviewed native/file/string/Biopython/OpenMM articles have current incremental receiving; this is not a full-current-site or installed/scientific certificate.

failure_disposition: Twelve original coordinate/copy cases fail: PDB count metadata/models, nonexistent extraction getter, Modeller shape/order/duplicate mismatch and shared topology, and direct PDB identity alias. Seventeen corrected cases then pass.

State public baseline has four UnknownArgumentError failures; two later direct hooks additionally expose nonexistent State.setPositions. Six corrected State cases pass. Four positive mutable-Context cases separately reproduce the shared selector-signature defect before repair.
The old MDTraj guard expects one model from a 38-model PDB. Its original failure is retained; the stronger guard checks every selected atom in all 38 models.

The first wider cohort has 476 passes and two errors from indexing an expected OpenMM list with a numpy-style list index. The expected-value reader is corrected without weakening geometry. A focused 34-case cohort passes before full documentation receiving.
Documentation baseline has 31 failures and eleven passes: absent links/counts, three omitted registered MolSys converters, two missing Simulation settings and PDB count delivery newly added by #735.

First corrected documentation has 52 passes/two failures: genuinely zero-byte setter modules cannot target line 1. Only explicitly empty modules may omit a line anchor; both fake empty-file anchors and unanchored callable references are negatively guarded. No source padding or placeholder functions are introduced.

One GitHub GraphQL issue-creation attempt fails; the complete board confirms no issue was created before the retry produces #736. This is not a scientific result or a demonstrated provider library defect.
limits: PDB projections update known OpenMM position caches; layout changes need renewed adapter receiving. Actual provider is fingerprinted separately from the inspected reference checkout.
PDB models share one reader topology/box; homogeneous model identity and chemical completeness are not newly validated or authenticated.
PDBFile-to-Modeller intentionally uses the first selected pose, model zero by default; a trajectory target instead keeps selected models.
MDTraj numerical arrays use its nm/float32 contract; this is not an arbitrary-precision promise or an energy/scientific-method certificate.
The direct identity reuse behavior of five other reader adapters is documented and owned by post-1.0 #737; faithful runtime/snapshot copying remains #592.

Early stage fingerprints cover selected source extensions and drafted tests, not every external input. Final receiving also fingerprints tracked JSON and actual form HTML; it is still not an exact-candidate certificate.
Thirteen-page Sphinx receiving disables notebook execution and autosummary regeneration. Applicable actual runtime controls and updated docstrings execute separately.
Remaining 26 flagged pages retain unchanged-source and byte-identical cached HTML receiving, not a newly rebuilt full public site.
Complete-source/nightly, original score, investigations, stable format/client, installed final-pair and publication pause remain.

# Convert to OpenMM Simulation
# Setting the temperature to 343 K (70 degrees Celsius) to simulate industrial heat
try:
    simulation = msm.convert(molsys, to_form='openmm.Simulation', 
                             forcefield='AMBER14', water_model='TIP3P-FB',
                             temperature='343 K')
    print(f"OpenMM Simulation ready: {type(simulation)}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"OpenMM initialization failed: {e}")

# Create an OpenMM Simulation object
# Note: This requires OpenMM installed.

    simulation = msm.convert(molsys, to_form='openmm.Simulation', 
                             forcefield='AMBER14', water_model='TIP3P-FB',
                             temperature='310 K')
    print(f"OpenMM Simulation ready: {type(simulation)}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"OpenMM conversion failed: {e}")
